name: Host machine
summary: The agent runs its shell commands and file edits directly on the user's own computer, with the same access as the user. This is the default for local coding agents and needs no setup, but the only protection comes from permission prompts or an OS-level sandbox around commands.
how: Agent process starts in a project folder on your machine
Shell and file tools act on the real filesystem and network
Risky actions go through permission prompts or an allowlist
Optionally wrap commands in an OS sandbox (Seatbelt, bubblewrap)
facts: Claude Code uses Seatbelt on macOS, bubblewrap on Linux/WSL2
Full access to your tools and files, and to your mistakes
goodFor: Interactive coding where you watch the agent
Using your installed tools, credentials and local services
watchOut: A bad command can damage your files or leak secrets
Unattended runs are risky without an OS sandbox
Work stops when the computer sleeps
